content_zh:
前前后后官榜总共旋转了有四个小时,直到苏沐感觉脑袋有些针刺般疼痛的时候,才算停止下来。
而这时已经是黄昏。
晚霞透过窗户射进病房,照在身上,苏沐缓缓睁开双眼。不知道为什么,车祸时撕心裂肺般的疼痛,现在消失的无影无踪,整个人比眼前还要精神。那几根断掉的骨头,就像没发生过任何事似的,没有一点不适。
“咦!”
苏沐瞧见坐在病床边有些困倦的叶惜,没有想到她竟然还在这里。刚刚翻了一下身,想着坐起来,叶惜这时睁开了双眼。
“苏沐,你醒了?感觉怎么样?要不要我叫医生?你想吃什么,我现在就给你去买。”叶惜急声道。
“别忙活了!”苏沐笑着坐起来,“叶惜,我没事,全好了!对了,你没事吧?没有伤到哪吧?”
“我没事!”叶惜说道:“你先别乱动,我把医生喊来!”
“真不用...”
苏沐的话还没有说完,叶惜便跑出病房,将在旁边守着的医生喊来。医生进来为苏沐很为仔细的检查一遍后,忍不住皱起眉头,有些难以相信的摇晃着脑袋。
“这怎么可能?你的骨头分明都断了,就算想动至少也得休养了半个月。奇怪了,你现在怎么一点事都没有?”
“或许是我身体好呗,要知道我当初在大学的时候,可是武协的会长。行了医生,我没事,在这里躺会就能出院了,您去忙吧。”苏沐笑着道。
“奇怪了,真的是奇怪了,难道这家伙的身体真的这么厉害?”医生自言自语着走出病房。
“你真的没事?”叶惜怀疑着问道:“别怕,如果你是害怕住院费的话,根本不用担心,一切有我那。”
“叶惜,我说好了真的好了,不信你瞧!”苏沐蹭的从床上坐起,很为利索的下地,有模有样的打了一套形意拳。
动作行云流水,哪里有半点受伤的迹象?
直到这时叶惜才相信,苏沐真的没事。
“你没事就好,刚才你不知道,真的很危险。谢谢你,要不是你的话,我想现在自己已经死了。”叶惜真诚道。
“和我这么客气干什么!好歹咱们都是一个院的,你有危险我总不能见死不救吧。”苏沐微笑着道。
“对了,苏沐大学毕业后怎么就没有你的消息了,你去哪了?”

“我能去哪?回老家当了个小公务员。”
“你现在是公务员?”
“你那什么眼神?不相信吗?告诉你,我可不是一般的公务员,我可是副镇长!”
“真的假的?”
“不相信吗?不相信的话有空去我那转转,让你瞧瞧。”
“吹牛吧你,还有你这次回来干什么的?怎么回来也不打声招呼?”
“糟糕!我的那些书那?”
“书?什么书?”
......
从苏沐的口中叶惜知道,他真的没有说谎,大学毕业后他便参加了市里面组织的公务员考试。虽然考上但因为没门没势力,结果被分配到老家黑山镇。因为分配之前在县政府办干了小半年,后来家里托了老远的亲戚才勉强让他回到黑山镇,并且成为了副镇长。
然而你千万别以为这个副镇长多牛逼,要知道在邢唐县,黑山镇就是穷困的代名词。再没有什么地方比黑山镇还要穷,要路没路,一望无际的大山横躺在这里。黑山镇穷到外面其余镇的人,都没有谁想着把闺女嫁过来。
谁家闺女嫁到黑山镇,那便意味着掉进了万丈火坑。
在这样的情况下,没有哪个干部想着来黑山镇,就算过来的也是干不了几天,便想尽办法调走。
苏沐作为江大的毕业生,作为当年公务员考试的第一名,加上那个亲戚的打招呼,分配到黑山镇后便被委以副镇长的身份。二十二岁的副镇长,主管黑山镇全镇的文化卫生工作,说穿了还是半点权力没有。
这次前来省城盛京市,苏沐办些私事的同时,另外的任务便是为黑山镇一个山村的小学生购买些书本。而在江大旁边有一个旧书市场,在那里买到书后,苏沐便想着趁天没黑赶回去,谁想到会撞上这事。

content_en:
The official list rotated back and forth for a total of four hours, and it wasn't until Su Mu felt a stabbing pain in her head that she finally stopped.
It was already dusk.
The sunset shot into the ward through the window and shone on her body. Su Mu slowly opened her eyes. I don’t know why, but the heartbreaking pain during the car accident has now disappeared without a trace, and I feel more energetic than before. Those broken bones acted as if nothing had happened and there was no discomfort at all.
"Eh!"
Su Mu saw Ye Xi sitting beside the hospital bed looking sleepy, but he didn't expect that she was still here. Just after turning over and thinking about sitting up, Ye Xi opened her eyes.
"Su Mu, are you awake? How do you feel? Do you want me to call the doctor? Whatever you want to eat, I will buy it for you right now." Ye Xi said urgently.
"Stop working!" Su Mu sat up with a smile, "Ye Xi, I'm fine, everything is fine! By the way, are you fine? No injuries, right?"
"I'm fine!" Ye Xi said, "Don't move around yet, I'll call the doctor!"
"It's really not necessary..."
Before Su Mu finished speaking, Ye Xi ran out of the ward and called the doctor who was guarding him. The doctor came in and examined Su Mu very carefully. He couldn't help frowning and shaking his head in disbelief.
"How is this possible? Your bones are obviously broken. Even if you want to move, you have to rest for at least half a month. It's strange, why are you okay now?"
"Maybe it's because I'm in good health. You should know that when I was in college, I was the president of the Wushu Association. After a doctor's appointment, I'm fine. I can lie here for a while and be discharged. You can go and do your work." Su Mu said with a smile.
"It's strange, it's really strange. Is this guy's body really so powerful?" The doctor said to himself and walked out of the ward.
"Are you really okay?" Ye Xi asked doubtfully, "Don't be afraid. If you are afraid of the hospital bills, there is no need to worry at all. I will take care of everything."
"Ye Xi, I said it was really good. If you don't believe me, just look!" Su Mu sat up from the bed, got down to the ground neatly, and performed a set of Xingyiquan in a decent manner.
The movements are smooth and fluid, but where is the slightest sign of injury?
Only then did Ye Xi believe that Su Mu was really fine.
"It's good that you're fine. You didn't know just now that it was really dangerous. Thank you. If it weren't for you, I think I would be dead now." Ye Xizhen said.
"Why are you being so polite to me? After all, we are all in the same hospital. I can't just ignore you when you are in danger." Su Mu said with a smile.
"By the way, why haven't I heard from you since Su Mu graduated from university? Where have you been?"
"Where can I go? Return to my hometown and work as a civil servant."
"Are you a civil servant now?"
"What's that look in your eyes? Don't you believe it? Let me tell you, I am not an ordinary civil servant, I am the deputy mayor!"
"Really or not?"
"Don't believe it? If you don't believe it, come to my place when you have time and let you take a look."
"Bragging, why are you coming back this time? Why didn't you say hello when you came back?"
"Oops! Where are my books?"
"Book? What book?"
...
From Su Mu's words, Ye Xi knew that he really wasn't lying. After graduating from college, he took the civil service examination organized by the city. Although he passed the exam, he was assigned to his hometown of Heishan Town because he had no choice but no power. Because he worked in the county government office for half a year before the assignment, his family later reluctantly allowed him to return to Heishan Town and became the deputy mayor after asking relatives from far away.
However, you must not think that this deputy mayor is awesome. You must know that in Xingtang County, Heishan Town is synonymous with poverty. There is no place as poor as Heishan Town. There are no roads and endless mountains lie here. Heishan Town is so poor that no one in the other towns outside wants to marry their daughter.
Whose daughter marries to Heishan Town?It means falling into a pit of fire.
Under such circumstances, no cadre thought of coming to Heishan Town, and even those who came could not work for a few days, so they tried their best to transfer them away.
As a graduate of Jiangnan University, Su Mu ranked first in the civil service examination that year, and with the greeting from that relative, he was assigned to Heishan Town and was appointed as the deputy mayor. The 22-year-old deputy mayor is in charge of the cultural and health work of Heishan Town. To put it bluntly, he has no power at all.
This time when Su Mu came to Shengjing City, the provincial capital, to do some personal things, his other task was to buy some books for primary school students in a mountain village in Heishan Town. There was a second-hand book market next to Jiang University. After buying books there, Su Mu thought about rushing back before dark. Who would have thought that she would run into this.
